subject: Grey grid on image after update R 2.9.0 ?

messages.author: ed16d5092d87349f
messages.subject: Grey grid on image after update R 2.9.0 ?
parts:
Dear all,

Yesterday, baptiste and Juliet resolved me a problem about align two
(or more) plots on a page (http://ggplot2.wik.is/Align_two_plots_on_a_page
). I have upgraded to R 2.9.0 (below I put my new R.Version). Now,
when I plot the image, there is a grey grid on top (see Image
attached). How can I erase that grid?

Thank you,

Angel.

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Grey grid on image after update R 2.9.0 ?
parts:
Hi,

it could be one of several things i suppose:

- visual artifact of the image viewer (such Moiré is typical of images
displayed in pdf viewers) --- but here you seem to use quartz so it
should not happen, i think

- you have set the colour of the tiles to the grey value (or perhaps
NA as grey is the default background). Try to set colour = "your
variable" in addition to fill = "your variable" in the aes() call.
Actually, after testing on a dummy example, it seems that you'd be
better off not specifying colour at all in aes() for some reason that
I don't really understand. Try both, then :). And it may be that the
type of your colour variable matters (factor or numeric?...)

- your data has some weird pattern in it (in which case, try to give a
reproducible example), at least str("your data.frame")

- perhaps something else

I'm guessing it's # 2

HTH,

baptiste

messages.subject: Re: Grey grid on image after update R 2.9.0 ?
parts:
Thanks for your response baptiste. I think the problem is
expand.grid() function. Please try this.

# ---------------------------
# Everything is all rigth
# ---------------------------

data<- t(volcano)[ncol(volcano):1,]

ggplot(melt(data), aes(x=X1,y=X2,fill=value))+geom_tile()


# -------------------------------
# Light grey lines appear
# -------------------------------

x<-1:87
y<-1:61
xy<-expand.grid(x=x,y=y)
d1 <- data.frame(x=x, y=rnorm(length(x)))
d2<-data.frame(x=xy$x,y=xy$y,z=as.vector(t(data)))

d1$panel <- "a"
d2$panel <- "c"

d1$z <- d1$x

d <- rbind(d1,d2)

p <- ggplot(data=d, mapping=aes(x = x,y = y))
p <- p + facet_grid(panel~.,scale="free")
p <- p + layer(data=d1, geom=c("line"), stat = "identity")
p <- p + layer(data=d2, mapping=aes(colour=z, fill=z), geom=c("tile"),
stat = "identity")

p

# ---------------------------------------------------------

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Grey grid on image after update R 2.9.0 ?
parts:
The problem seems to arise when you specify both colour and fill in
the aes (last line). It has nothing to do with the data or
expand.grid, as can be seen in this minimal example,


d<- t(volcano)[ncol(volcano):1,]

p <-
ggplot(melt(d), aes(x=X1,y=X2,fill=value))+geom_tile()

p # correct appearance
p + aes(colour=value) # 'greyish' grid

I'm not sure why this behaviour is observed, it may have something to
do with the linewidth of the squares that is slightly too thin to
merge the neighbouring elements together.

Anyway, if you don't need it, just remove colour in aes().

HTH,

baptiste
